# Vendored spreadsheet reader

`xlsx.full.min.js` is the unmodified SheetJS Community Edition 0.20.3 standalone browser build. Its Apache-2.0 license is included as `LICENSE.sheetjs.txt`.

- Official installation and vendoring instructions: <https://docs.sheetjs.com/docs/getting-started/installation/standalone/>
- Exact script: <https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/package/dist/xlsx.full.min.js>
- Exact license: <https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/package/LICENSE>

The checked-in copy makes Excel import independent of third-party CDN availability. The app reads workbook contents in the browser; it does not upload workbooks to SheetJS.
